name: net_session_config_dialog_cleanup_map_name_strings_on_exit
description: NetSessionConfigDialog::CleanupMapNameStringsOnExit destroys the static CString list of multiplayer map names. Direct production host: mission.cpp.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
Binary Ninja keeps the MSVC_EH_ArrayDestructor helper visible for this compiler-generated cleanup callback. The rebuilt source spells the equivalent reverse CString destructor loop explicitly.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x41ca10 pushes CString::~CString, count 7, element size 4, and g_NetSessionConfigDialog_MapNameStrings before calling MSVC_EH_ArrayDestructor.
The native smoke patches the MFC CString destructor import, calls CleanupMapNameStringsOnExit, and verifies seven destructor calls against map-name entries 6 through 0.
